verdict.rationale:
Undermind's core product is an AI assistant to which users delegate open-ended research goals: it autonomously plans searches, follows citations/authors, reads full-text PDFs, and produces a synthesized report, stopping only when it exhausts relevant literature — a clear built-in-assistant delegation model. Community reviews corroborate that it functions as an autonomous research agent (though quality of results varies).

missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the full delegation UX (not just search quality) and more detail on how task scope/goals are specified in-app.
